messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, you look
older than me, but{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}how old
are you exactly?
{07 14 00}And do you want to have
a shouting contest,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}

{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}I meant to apologize
for calling you a two-faced
toad the other day.
{07 00 00}I didn't mean it. {01 00 00 05 00}You just
caught me at a bad time,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}tahtsin vabandada,
et nimetasin sind hiljuti
kahepalgeliseks konnaks.
{07 00 00}Ma ei mõelnud seda. {01 00 00 05 00}Sa
tabasid mind lihtsalt
halval hetkel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 1d 00}The key to success{01 00 00 0a 00} is
practice!{07 00 00}{01 01 00} I practiced EVERY
DAY for a month!
{09 04 00}Why do people even bother
challenging me?!{01 01 00} {07 0a 00}Because I
ALWAYS win! {01 00 00 05 00}Ooh, snap!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 1d 00}Edu võti{01 00 00 0a 00} on
harjutamine!{07 00 00}{01 01 00} Harjutasin
IGA PÄEV terve kuu!
{09 04 00}Miks üldse vaevutakse
mind välja kutsuma?!{01 01 00} {07 0a 00}Sest
ma võidan ALATI! {01 00 00 05 00}Oeh!

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}You did WHAT?! {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00}Well, in all
fairness, I guess I should
come clean about
{07 0a 00}launching that bottle
rocket into your window
last summer. {01 00 00 0f 00}{ff 00 00 04}{07 13 00}It was SO fun!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}Sa tegid MIDA?! {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00}Noh, ausalt
öeldes peaksin ma vist
tunnistama, et
{07 0a 00}lasin mullu suvel
pudeliraketi sinu
aknasse. {01 00 00 0f 00}{ff 00 00 04}{07 13 00}See oli NII lõbus!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}YOU did that?! {01 00 00 05 00}{09 01 00}{07 14 00}It singed the
first 200 pages of my
insult thesaurus!{09 01 00}{07 00 00}{09 02 00}
{07 0f 00}For three whole weeks, I
couldn't find any synonyms
for "doofus"!
{07 01 00}FINE!{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 11 00} I didn't REALLY mean it
when I told {ff 00 00 06}Phyllis{ff 00 00 00} that you
think she looks clownish.{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}SINA?! {01 00 00 05 00}{09 01 00}{07 14 00}See kõrvetas
mu solvangusõnastiku
esimesed 200 lehte!{09 01 00}{07 00 00}{09 02 00}
{07 0f 00}Terve kolm nädalat ei
leidnud ma ühtegi sünonüümi
sõnale „tolvan”!
{07 01 00}HEA KÜLL!{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 11 00} Ma ei mõelnud
TÕESTI seda, kui ütlesin
{ff 00 00 06}Phyllisele{ff 00 00 00}, et ta on kloun.{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}So that's why she's always
so rude to me!{01 00 00 0f 00} I thought it
was just jealousy!
{07 00 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}remember the other
day when I said you looked
really dashing?
{07 14 00}Sorry about that. {01 00 00 05 00}It was a
total lie. {01 00 00 05 00}You looked like an
old boot. {09 02 00}{07 02 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}{09 01 00}{07 03 00}Ooh, burn!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 02 00}Sellepärast ta ongi minuga
alati ebaviisakas!{01 00 00 0f 00} Arvasin,
et see on lihtsalt kadedus!
{07 00 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}mäletad, kui ma
ütlesin, et sa näed
tõeliselt kena välja?
{07 14 00}Vabandust. {01 00 00 05 00}See oli
täielik vale. {01 00 00 05 00}Sa nägid välja
nagu vana saabas. {09 02 00}{07 02 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}{09 01 00}{07 03 00}Põleb!

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 02 00}Hey!{01 00 00 0f 00} So you're saying that a
good heart and personality
mean nothing?{09 01 00}{07 00 00}{09 02 00}
{07 19 00}You're becoming snobbier
and snobbier every day,
aren't you?
{07 00 00}There are people out there
just trying to make an
honest living, you know?!
{07 15 00}I mean, {01 00 00 0a 00}just look at that
weirdo staring at us,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 02 00}Hei!{01 00 00 0f 00} Nii et sa ütled, et
hea süda ja iseloom
ei tähenda midagi?{09 01 00}{07 00 00}{09 02 00}
{07 19 00}Sa muutud iga päevaga
üha upsakamaks,
kas pole?
{07 00 00}On inimesi, kes lihtsalt
üritavad ausalt
elatist teenida, tead?!
{07 15 00}Vaata kasvõi {01 00 00 0a 00}seda
veidrikku, kes meid vahib,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 04 00}Wow, I totally didn't expect
that, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Imagine
that!
{07 14 00}I just assumed you were
still living the hobo life,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 04 00}Ohoo, seda ma küll ei
oodanud, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Mõelda
vaid!
{07 14 00}Ma lihtsalt eeldasin, et sa
elad ikka hulkuri elu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
